clues: This city sits in a broad valley in the centre of its land, in the Himalaya lands of Asia. Old temples and palaces fill its streets.
Most rain here rides in on the summer monsoon winds, from June to September. Warm days give way to cool nights, and winter cold can touch freezing.
A Licchavi king merged two old towns to found this city. It later served for ages as the royal capital of the kingdom.
Think of this city as the front door to the Himalayas. Trips to the high peaks start from its busy streets, and guests fill its lanes.
This city is the main seat of government for Nepal. The nation's rule, money, work, and culture all centre here.
